name: OLMo 3 3B
statusSub: Reproducible record (Tier 1); not a Certified reproduction
summary: The published OLMo-core 3B scaling-ladder architecture trained from scratch for one bounded optimizer step on a pinned public Dolma 3 subset. The 3B rung is the largest upstream rung that fits one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition; architecture and context length were unchanged, while topology was adapted at E0 and batch, duration, evaluation, and public-data preparation at E2. The run publishes a deterministic complete checkpoint archive and metrics with Clean-DAG 14/14 and AI-BOM 100/100. It makes no convergence claim and has not received independent cold certification.
difficulty: 8/10 — the 3B rung fits narrowly and its published ladder data root required a public-data adaptation

truncation.note: One 8,192-token optimizer step of the upstream 4×-Chinchilla duration. This verifies execution and artifact production only; it does not establish convergence or model quality.

rebuild.hw: 1× NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

fullRun.estimateBasis: No defensible dollar estimate can be derived from one first optimizer step. The observation includes compilation and fixed checkpoint/publication work, while upstream full training uses a different global batch and multi-device topology; multiplying either total wall time or first-step time would publish false precision.
changes: restore the upstream target global-batch calculation and topology-compatible rounding
restore the 4×-Chinchilla duration of 253,562,982,400 tokens and its checkpoint schedule
provide a complete public tokenized form of the intended ladder training mix
fullRun.caveats: The recorded 3B rung nearly fills one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, and this capture does not imply that the full recipe is practical on one device.

issues.title: The published ladder defaults to a non-public tokenized data root
issues.detail: The public ladder entry point constructs DataMix.OLMo_mix_0925 below gs://ai2-llm/. Its local run command therefore lacks an anonymously readable input and a public preparation path for the intended tokenized mix.
issues.fix: publish an immutable manifest and preparation command for the intended ladder mix
